PRIVATE AND CONFIDENTIAL

Ashvale Components Ltd
3 June 2025

Dear Ms Rowe,

TERMINATION OF EMPLOYMENT

You commenced employment with the company on 3 March 2019.

Following the disciplinary hearing, the company has decided to terminate
your contract of employment. Your employment terminates with effect from
12 July 2025.

Yours sincerely,

J. Hallam
Head of Human Resources

facts.sentence: Your employment terminates with effect from 12 July 2025.
You commenced employment with the company on 3 March 2019.
